relationships.subject: axial compression
relationships.evidence_quote: Axial compression is one of the critical pathological factors to cause IDD and LBP, and there was a strong positive correlation depended on the duration and magnitude of compression.

key_findings: Axial compression induced IDD and low back pain markers (CGRP, SP) in a duration- and magnitude-dependent manner.
Compression reduced aggrecan and collagen II and increased IL-1β and MMP-3 in mouse coccygeal discs.
